message:
docs(history): the missing Release target was a stale tree, not a wiring defect

CMakeLists has no EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL anywhere, and the stop-process target is
declared exactly like update_effects_test beside it, so it is in the default
build. It was absent from the verifier's Release tree because that tree had not
been rebuilt since the target was added. The observation was still worth acting
on -- the counterexample needed to be shown running in the shipping config -- but
the cause was not what it looked like.

Also recorded: the verifier deliberately did not reproduce the 1803 total. With
totals already agreed to be unusable as evidence, a long rebuild to confirm one
buys nothing. What they cross-checked was per-suite: they had seen
udp_control_e2e pass 18 in their own earlier Debug sweep and fail later, which is
direct observation of the same suite splitting by time rather than by config;
viewer_udp_recovery's rc=127 traced to build staleness in their tree; and they
built and ran stop_process in Release themselves.

And the provenance closes: dist/GNLinkSetup-0.2.110.exe hashes to the bytes they
fetched from the public URL, so the local artifact and the published one are the
same file.
